subject: Marketplace liaison: technical entitlement path & PM-led co-sell milestones
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudforge.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace liaison: technical entitlement path & PM-led co-sell milestones

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for agreeing to take a look. Quick context: CloudForge is preparing an AWS and GCP marketplace listing and we want Redwood to be our preferred co-sell runtime for inference workloads. Legal and GTM are aligned on headline terms, but engineering needs a clear entitlement and metering path so our listing passes the marketplace certification checks.

Primary asks for the technical sync:
- SKU/entitlement model recommendations (multi-SKU vs single SKU with metering tags)
- Metering hook examples and billing signal we should emit from our platform
- A short list of evidence items your marketplace team expects (sample telemetry, integration test artifacts, role/permission matrix)
- Any recommended guardrails for hosted vs dedicated deployments so marketplace customers understand pricing tiers

I attached our preliminary listing requirements (cloudforge_listing_requirements.pdf). Could we do a 45-minute technical/ops sync next week? Samantha + Devon will join from our side.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Strategic Partnerships, CloudForge AI
samantha.lee@cloudforge.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: cloudforge_listing_requirements.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace liaison: technical entitlement path & PM-led co-sell milestones

Samantha — great to meet this thread. Thanks for the doc; skimmed it and there are a few items we should align on before certification.

I propose the following agenda for the 45m sync:
1) SKU & entitlement model (Ben to lead recommendations)
2) Metering signal: events + expected packet format (Eng lead)
3) Evidence checklist (what we can provide vs what you must produce)
4) Timeline & go/no-go gates for co-sell enablement

Preliminary asks from our side (so you can prep):
- Example telemetry sample (json) showing request/response token counts and pricing tags
- A short explainer of your billing model (subscription vs usage, unit definitions)
- Owner names for legal/contact for marketplace paperwork

Ben/Olga — looping you in to own SKU & GTM steps. Ben, please bring the SKU coupling guidance we used for the Nimbus listing as a reference. Olga, can you note the evidence items we should expect for AWS/GCP cert?

Proposed times: Tue 21 May 10:00 PT or Wed 22 May 14:00 PT. Which works?

Best,
Karthik
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199

Looping in a short checklist + suggested MAP items based on prior marketplace launches. Karthik, happy to lead the SKU recommendation and coordinate the co-sell enablement workstream.

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): technical intake + meter schema (CloudForge)
- Week 1: Redwood to propose SKU mapping and sample pricing tags
- Week 2: Evidence bundle compiled (both sides) and test harness run
- Week 3: Legal to exchange cert addendum / marketplace paperwork
- Week 4: Pilot listing + early co-sell routing (soft launch)

Success criteria: pilot customers onboarded, billing telemetry matches accounting, co-sell leads routed to CloudForge/Redwood SDR queue.

Samantha/Devon — who will own the billing schema doc on your side? If you can drop the draft to the shared doc (link below) before our sync, we can iterate quickly.

- Evidence tab: list of telemetry samples, role/permission matrix, and required test artifacts for AWS/GCP certification

DocuSign: we will circulate an MOU after we finalize the MAP. Placeholder link: https://www.docusign.com/execute?doc=0a1b2c3d4e5f
